name: methodsmith
description: Rigorous methods for statistics, machine learning, and meta-analysis, from question to paper. Every study compounds.

interface.longDescription: Methodsmith is a plugin for Claude Code and Codex that turns your agent into a careful research-methods partner for statistics, machine learning, and meta-analysis. Frame the question, pre-specify the analysis plan, build cohorts and Table 1, fit and check models, run reporting-checklist and methods review, and draft the paper. Each study's lessons compound into the next. Works with R and Python, Quarto, Jupyter, and marimo. Built on Every's Compound Engineering plugin.
